tools.name: search_countries
tools.description: Find countries by name or ISO code and see whether LibrePass offers an eSIM there. Returns at most 10 matches with their ids.

tools.name: list_packages
tools.description: List the eSIM packages for one country: data volume, validity, speed, price in EUR (VAT included), daily plans, the monthly pool and the mobile networks used. Includes the page url to choose a plan.

tools.name: get_package
tools.description: Details of one package by the id that list_packages returned, e.g. "tr-10gb-30d" or "tr-daily-3gb".

tools.name: sim_registration_rules
tools.description: Whether a prepaid SIM or eSIM must be registered to an identity in a country, who must register, with which document, and what happens otherwise. Includes the official source and check date. General information, not legal advice.
